purpose: Rerun the primary, zero-treatment, subperiod, and forgetting-factor F block-shuffle surrogate comparisons with enough draws to resolve probabilities around 0.01.
random_seed_policy: Continue each previously declared deterministic seed stream from its first draw; record the seed offsets and seed family in the result artifact. Retain the earlier 499-draw R and H raw probabilities, which remain valid, and recompute their Holm family adjustments jointly with the new F raw probability.

method.shuffle: Existing circular block-shuffle implementation, unchanged block length and test dates.
method.test: Existing two-sided empirical F probability, with the existing plus-one correction; compute F5 directly from each fitted Jacobian path.
method.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the existing R and H raw probabilities and the new F raw probability within each primary, zero-treatment, and lambda comparison; Holm across the two prespecified subperiod F probabilities.
zero_treatments: exact-zero observations treated as missing for the per-asset measurement update

scope_limit: This extension updates only post-freeze surrogate p-value resolution and associated descriptive summaries. It does not alter the frozen result file, protocol, thresholds, analyses, or verdicts.
